overview.problemStatement: The registration path shows its seams: blank screens while Convex data loads, actions that wait for a round-trip, white screens when a query throws, and empty states that say nothing useful.
overview.proposedSolution: Add a reusable skeleton primitive and route-level loading skeletons, optimistic registration and cancellation with rollback and announcement, route error boundaries with retry, and one empty-state component that names the reason and the next action.
overview.targetAudience: Attendees registering on mid-range phones and unreliable networks, and organisers affected by duplicate registrations from impatient double taps.
assumptions: The installed Convex client supports optimistic updates.
BP-015 delivered the live-region provider and useAnnounce hook.
No backend or schema change is required.

userStories.title: See the shape of the page immediately
userStories.want: the page structure to appear while data loads
userStories.benefit: I know the page is working and can start reading headings

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a cold load of an event or ticket page, a skeleton that mirrors the final layout renders within the first frame and is replaced by real content without the page jumping.
Given the registration dialog, the submit control shows a pending state and ignores further taps until the request settles.

userStories.title: Act without waiting for the network
userStories.want: the ticket to appear the moment I confirm
userStories.benefit: I trust that the registration worked

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a confirmed registration, the ticket appears in my-tickets immediately and remains once the server confirms.
Given a failed registration or cancellation, the optimistic change rolls back and the reason is announced.

userStories.title: Recover from a broken render
userStories.want: a way out when a page fails
userStories.benefit: one bad query does not strand me

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a render error on an event or ticket route, an error boundary shows a recovery message with retry and a working link home, and navigation stays usable.

userStories.title: Understand an empty screen
userStories.want: to know why a list is empty and what to do next
userStories.benefit: I do not assume the app is broken

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given an empty ticket list, search result set, or announcements list, the state names its cause and offers the relevant next action.
Given skeleton and optimistic transitions, cumulative layout shift on the affected routes stays at or below 0.02.
Given a user with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, skeleton shimmer and transition motion are suppressed.

functionalRequirements.text: A reusable skeleton primitive MUST exist under components/ui/ and be the only shimmer implementation.
The event page and my-tickets MUST render route-level loading skeletons that match their final layout.
The registration dialog MUST disable its submit control and show progress while a request is in flight, and MUST NOT send a second request.
Registration and cancellation MUST apply optimistically through the Convex client and reconcile with the server result.
Optimistic updates MUST roll back on error and announce the failure through the existing live region.
Event and ticket routes MUST provide error boundaries that keep the header and navigation usable and offer retry.
Empty states MUST be produced by one component that takes a reason and an optional action.
Skeleton and transition animation MUST be suppressed when the user prefers reduced motion.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Cumulative layout shift on the affected routes MUST stay at or below 0.02.
The skeleton and empty-state primitives MUST add at most 5 KB gzip to first-load JavaScript.
Skeletons MUST be hidden from assistive technology and the loading state announced once; errors MUST be announced.
No Convex function signature, validator, or authorization check may change; this feature is client presentation.
